name: Kakatiya Textiles Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Kakatiya Textiles Ltd manufactures and sells cotton yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KKL is in the cotton yarn spinning yarn dyeing and cotton ginning business. It has a production
 unit in Andhra Pradesh with an installed 
 capacity of 25,000 spindles. Company 
is using its manufacturing unit for job conversion work of other textile units

pros: Debtor days have improved from 55.8 to 25.1 days.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.85% over past five years.
